{{Current events|year=2019|month=08|day=14|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Syrian Civil War]], [[Northwestern Syria offensive (April 2019-present)|2019 Northwestern Syria offensive]]
**A [[Syrian Air Force]] [[Sukhoi Su-22]] jet is [[List of aviation shootdowns and accidents during the Syrian Civil War|shot down]] by rebel forces near the town of [[Khan Shaykhun]] in the [[Idlib Governorate]], [[Syria]]. [[Hayat Tahrir al-Sham]] [[Jihadism|jihadists]] say they have captured the pilot. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-49348064 (BBC)] [https://www.almasdarnews.com/article/jihadists-shoot-down-syrian-fighter-jet-in-southern-idlib/ (Al Masdar News)]

;Business and economy
*[[Economy of Germany]]
**The [[Federal Statistical Office of Germany]] discloses that [[Germany]]'s [[gross domestic product]] shrank by 0.1% in the second quarter. [https://www.theguardian.com/business/live/2019/aug/14/germany-economy-shrinks-gdp-recession-uk-inflation-stock-markets-business-live (''The Guardian'')]
*The [[Scholarly Publishing and Academic Resources Coalition]], a U.S.-based organization that aims to keep educational materials broadly accessible, has asked the [[United States Department of Justice Antitrust Division|Antitrust Division]] of the [[United States Department of Justice|Justice Department]] to halt a planned merger between two large textbook companies, [[McGraw-Hill]] and [[Cengage]], a merger it claims will cause students "irreparable harm". [https://finance.yahoo.com/news/education-group-urges-u-justice-155402326.html (Reuters)]

;Health and environment
*[[California]] regulators announce a ban on [[chlorpyrifos]], an organophosphate [[nerve agent]] used as a pesticide. [https://www.latimes.com/business/story/2019-08-14/california-bans-pesticide-defying-trump-epa (''Los Angeles Times'')]
*[[France]] bans [[electric pulse fishing]]. [https://news.yahoo.com/amphtml/france-outlaws-pulse-fishing-ahead-eu-wide-ban-184143492.html (AFP via Yahoo News}]

;Law and crime
*[[August 2019 Philadelphia shooting]]
**Six police officers are shot, sustaining non-life threatening injuries, by a gunman in [[Philadelphia]]; a seventh officer is injured in a related automobile accident nearby. [https://edition.cnn.com/us/live-news/philadelphia-shooting-08-14-19/index.html (CNN)] [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/police-fired-upon-philadelphia-they-respond-shooting-incident-n1042436 (NBC News)]
*[[Nisour Square massacre]]
**In a third trial, Nicholas Slatten is sentenced to [[Life imprisonment|life in prison]]. [https://www.voanews.com/usa/ex-blackwater-guard-gets-life-prison-2007-baghdad-massacre?amp (AFP via VoA)]

;Politics and elections
*[[Crisis in Venezuela]]
**Venezuelan President [[Nicolás Maduro]] creates a new government ministry, the Ministry of Tourism and Foreign Trade. [https://venezuelanalysis.com/news/14628 (Venezuelanalysis)]
**[[Tarek William Saab]] strips the parliamentary immunity of the opposition politicians Juan Pablo García, [[Tomás Guanipa]] and José Guerra. [https://venezuelanalysis.com/news/14628 (Venezuelanalysis)]
**A Norwegian delegation arrives in Venezuela to restart dialogues to end the [[2019 Venezuelan presidential crisis|presidential crisis]]. [https://ca.reuters.com/article/topNews/idCAKCN1V41SC-OCATP (Reuters)]
<!-- All news items above this line -->}}
